reponse:
There's no agreed figure yet. Our planning assumption is that Corvane's per-item ACH fee stays at **$0.08** in 2027, but that's an assumption in the Q1 pricing memo, not a signed rate — and the memo flags that if the per-item fee goes above $0.10 the bottom pricing tier has to be revisited [9]. The current Corvane agreement only runs to March 31, 2027, and renewal talks were to be opened in November [9]. More recently, Marcus said Corvane's RM hinted they want to raise the per-item fee after the Nov 10 reject mess, with "nothing on paper yet"; the call slipped to the week of Nov 23 [10].

For context on the current cost: Corvane's October fee invoice was $14,212.40 for 177,655 ACH items [8].
